name: Yureru Kyonyuu Chijo Ressha ~Chikan Saretai Onna-tachi~
original_name: 揺れる巨乳恥女列車～痴漢されたい女達～
source:
Main heroine is a mediocre OL. One day she witnesses another woman molested in the train and calls police. However, victim admits that she is perverted and thus got deliberately insulted. This encounter ruins the normal everyday for the heroine...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角篠原美雪是一名平凡的公司职员。某天，她在电车里目睹另一名女性遭到猥亵，立刻报了警。受害者却承认自己是个变态，故意让人这样羞辱。自这场邂逅起，美雪平静的日常彻底崩塌……

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-september-2005-gunjou-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
